curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a barrage of otherworldly visitors force television's most cynical executive to face his past and change his ways before it is too late?
curatedMovie.description: Ruthless television executive Frank Cross has alienated everyone around him, including the love of his life. After callously firing an employee on Christmas Eve, he is confronted by supernatural spirits.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A funny, moderately emotional holiday fantasy with steady pacing and thoughtful edge, ideal for an easy-watch night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its comedy-fantasy setup turns a Christmas Eve workplace clash into a spirited chance for Frank to confront his past.
